kit: unenchanted diamond sword and full diamond armor, 20 health, regeneration off
arena: 24 by 24 stone floor with barrier walls

training.opponents: current policies, archived policies, learned opponents that beat the incumbent
training.starts: ordinary duels plus replayed prefixes sampled uniformly in time in training-only duels
training.selection: 0.8 times mean paired duel payoff plus 0.2 times worst opponent payoff on the registered learned cross-play field, seed 193721; no scripted opponent is used for training or selection

evaluation.metric: wins, losses, draws and final health difference
evaluation.baseline: plain W-tap with charged swings and the common aim controller
evaluation.latency_note: Model one-way delay is quantized to ticks. Native comparison uses a delayed loopback TCP connection on top of loopback overhead. Native repeats share a starting protocol, not the exact game state.
evaluation.second_opponent: also run the frozen policy and W-tap against an independently trained opponent when feasible
evaluation.timing_scope: Both seats at 0 and 100 ms added RTT. Native uses independent real-time matches. Accelerated native pilot runs are development only.

split: Model training and evaluation generate independent schedules, without recorded human timing donors. No claim of transfer to held-out human calendars. Native evaluation runs use newly generated schedules.
